title: Non-Conforming Commercial Uses in Manufacturing Districts
previewText: In all Manufacturing Districts, any non-conforming commercial use may be changed, initially or in any subsequent change, only to a conforming use or to any use listed in Use Groups VI or VIII, other than an outdoor amusement park.
